HAND OF THE WICKED

scenes.a: If someone's malice or quiet hostility has made you fearful today, listen to this promise.
Ye that love the LORD, hate evil: he preserveth the souls of his saints;
he delivereth them out of the hand of the wicked.
Lord, cover this beloved soul who seeks to walk uprightly in Your sight.
When hidden traps are set or sharp words are spoken against them, be their fortress and shield.
Guard their inner spirit from all corruption, and pull them safely out of every snare crafted by deceitful hands.
Let no weapon formed in secret stand against Your chosen ones.
Subscribe to The Covenant Shield to rest under God's protection every day.
